decisions.rationale: Lead Floette + Farigiraf pressures the expected rain core while Armor Tail blocks Fake Out/Aqua Jet and Trick Room reverses Swift Swim. Heliolisk punishes rain with Dry Skin and Electric pressure; Mawile provides Intimidate and a strong Mega option into Archaludon or physical endgames.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 selected four: Floette-Eternal, Farigiraf, Heliolisk, Mawile. Primary anti-rain structure is Floette/Farigiraf with Heliolisk in back; Armor Tail denies opposing priority including Fake Out and Aqua Jet. Consider Trick Room whenever Pelipper rain plus Mega Swampert is positioned. Preserve Mega choice: Mega Floette is default versus rain; Mega Mawile is favored versus Archaludon/slower physical endgames.

decisions.rationale: Lead Pelipper and Swampert to immediately set Drizzle and activate Swampertite Mega Evolution into Swift Swim, applying overwhelming rain-boosted pressure with Basculegion and Archaludon in the back.
decisions.notebook: Rain core featuring Pelipper, Swampert, Basculegion, and Archaludon dominates this matchup against their offensive options.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Floette-Eternal)
decisions.rationale: Mega Floette’s Energy Ball is a guaranteed OHKO on Swampert across its legal bulk, including Mega Swampert, before it can move. Trick Room punishes Pelipper Tailwind and makes the remaining slow-mode plan with Farigiraf/Mawile highly favorable.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 four: Floette-Eternal, Farigiraf, Heliolisk, Mawile. Floette-Mega has Fairy Aura, 227 SpA and 154 Speed with this spread; Mega Energy Ball is a guaranteed OHKO on Swampert across legal bulk. Armor Tail denies opposing priority, including Fake Out and Aqua Jet. Rain matchup plan: use Floette/Farigiraf to remove Swampert and leverage Trick Room against Tailwind; preserve Heliolisk for Water pressure. Mega Mawile remains the preferred option only if Floette has not Mega Evolved and an Archaludon/slower physical endgame develops.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper sets Tailwind to secure speed control, and Mega-Swampert uses Waterfall on Farigiraf to pressure Trick Room or pick up a heavy KO while Armor Tail prevents priority moves.
decisions.notebook: Rain core of Pelipper, Swampert, Basculegion, and Archaludon provides excellent coverage against Farigiraf, Floette-Eternal, and backline options like Heliolisk, Mawile, Rotom-Fan, and Tauros-Paldea-Combat.

decisions.rationale: Swampert fainted last turn under Trick Room. We bring in Basculegion to leverage Choice Scarf speed and high-power Ghost/Water STAB against Floette-Mega and Farigiraf, while Pelipper protects or positions in Rain.
decisions.notebook: Rain core vs Trick Room opponent. Basculegion and Archaludon are backline threats; manage TR turns carefully.

decisions.rationale: Helping Hand maximizes Floette’s Energy Ball damage into Basculegion (80.2–146.7%), giving the best chance to remove the Choice Scarf attacker before it can act under Trick Room. Armor Tail already blocks its Aqua Jet.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 four: Floette-Eternal, Farigiraf, Heliolisk, Mawile. Floette-Mega has Fairy Aura, 227 SpA and 154 Speed; Energy Ball guaranteed OHKOs Mega Swampert but only deals 53.7–98.5% to Basculegion unboosted and 80.2–146.7% with Helping Hand. Farigiraf’s Armor Tail blocks opposing priority, including Aqua Jet and Fake Out. Rain matchup plan: establish Trick Room against Tailwind, remove Water attackers with Floette/Heliolisk, and retain Mawile for a slower physical Archaludon endgame if appropriate.

decisions.rationale: Under Trick Room, Basculegion's Choice Scarf speed advantage reverses, making it act later. Wave Crash into Floette-Mega and Pelipper's Hydro Pump pressure the opponent.
decisions.notebook: Maintain aggressive pressure in rain. Watch out for Trick Room duration and Farigiraf's Armor Tail stopping priority.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Helping Hand-boosted Fairy Aura Moonblast is a guaranteed OHKO on Archaludon before it can use Flash Cannon under Trick Room. Removing the immediate Steel threat preserves Floette and leaves Pelipper alone against all four remaining Pokémon.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 brought Floette-Mega, Farigiraf, Heliolisk, and Mawile. Floette-Mega: Modest, 227 SpA/154 Spe, Fairy Aura. Farigiraf: Sassy, 72 Spe, Armor Tail; Armor Tail blocks opposing priority including Aqua Jet and Fake Out. Floette Energy Ball guaranteed OHKOs Mega Swampert; versus Basculegion it dealt 53.7–98.5% normally and 80.2–146.7% with Helping Hand. Helping Hand + Fairy Aura Moonblast from Floette is a guaranteed OHKO on open-sheet Archaludon. Rain matchup plan: establish Trick Room against Tailwind, remove Water attackers with Floette/Heliolisk, retain Mawile for slower physical Archaludon endgames.

decisions.rationale: Floette-Mega is at 56% HP and weak to Steel. Flash Cannon from Archaludon into Floette-Mega heavily damages or KOs it. Pelipper hits Floette-Mega with Hydro Pump in rain to secure the knockout or press damage while Trick Room is active. Trick Room has 3 turns left and Tailwind has 2 turns left.

Helping Hand resolves before Floette’s Moonblast; under Trick Room Floette attacks before Pelipper’s normal-priority move. Helping Hand + Fairy Aura Moonblast is a guaranteed OHKO on full-health Pelipper.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 durable: Floette-Mega has 227 SpA, 154 Spe, Modest, Fairy Aura. Farigiraf is Sassy, 72 Spe, Armor Tail; Armor Tail blocks opposing priority. In rain matchup, Farigiraf Helping Hand plus Floette Fairy Aura Moonblast guarantees an OHKO on full-health Pelipper. Floette Energy Ball OHKOs Mega Swampert; Helping Hand Energy Ball OHKOs Basculegion; Helping Hand Moonblast OHKOs Archaludon. Mawile is Brave and slow, intended for Trick Room physical endgames; Mega Mawile Play Rough into Pelipper is only a possible, not guaranteed, OHKO without Helping Hand.

decisions.rationale: Hydro Pump in rain reliably KOs the 11% HP Floette-Mega regardless of accuracy checks (or we can clean up Farigiraf next). Archaludon is fainted and must pass.
decisions.notebook: Keep in mind Pelipper's rain-boosted Hydro Pump. Floette-Mega is weak to heavy pressure. Farigiraf uses Trick Room and Armor Tail.

reflections.summary: Won because Floette-Mega/Farigiraf was an excellent preview plan into rain: Trick Room neutralized Tailwind, while Helping Hand-boosted Floette coverage cleanly removed Swampert, Basculegion, Archaludon, and Pelipper. The same four and Floettite were well suited to this opponent.
reflections.adjustment: No major change needed: retain Floette-Mega, Farigiraf, Heliolisk, and Mawile as the rain matchup four, with Floette/Farigiraf as the preferred lead. Next game, be prepared for Raichu as a likely adjustment and avoid relying on Heliolisk attacks into Lightning Rod.
reflections.notebook: Game 1 durable: Opponent led Pelipper + Mega Swampert, used Tailwind immediately, and brought Basculegion and Archaludon; Raichu and Tsareena were omitted. Pelipper is Damp Rock with Hurricane, Hydro Pump, Tailwind, Protect; Basculegion is Choice Scarf Adaptability; Archaludon is Shuca Berry with Electro Shot, Draco Meteor, Flash Cannon, Protect. Floette-Mega + Farigiraf is a strong rain plan: Trick Room offsets Tailwind, Energy Ball removes Swampert/Basculegion, and Helping Hand Moonblast removes Archaludon/Pelipper. Keep the same four available, but respect a potential Raichu/Lightning Rod adjustment before committing Heliolisk.

reflections.summary: The opponent successfully set up Trick Room with Farigiraf under Armor Tail protection while Mega Floette used Fairy Aura-boosted Helping Hand attacks to rapidly dismantle Swampert, Basculegion, and Archaludon.
reflections.adjustment: Bring Archaludon and Pelipper alongside anti-Trick Room or faster pressure options to prevent Farigiraf from setting up, rather than relying on Swift Swim sweepers that get reversed by Trick Room.
reflections.notebook: Floette-Mega uses Fairy Aura and relies on Helping Hand support with Farigiraf's Trick Room and Armor Tail.
